## Zoning Analysis: 1218 W George St, Chicago, IL
**PIN:** 14291230290000 | **Parcel resolution:** authoritative (county address records)

---

### 1. Zoning District in Effect

This parcel is zoned **RT-4** (Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District), per ordinance **23082T1** on file with the city. You can verify this on the official Chicago Zoning Map: [gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning).

---

### 2. Is Residential Use Allowed?

**Yes — residential use is the primary permitted use in RT-4.** The RT districts are expressly residential two-flat, townhouse and multi-unit districts. The existing building is already a 3-unit, 2-story residential structure built in 1882, consistent with this classification.

---

### 3. Key Bulk and Density Standards (RT-4)

The retrieved code text does not include the full RT-4 bulk table, so the following are the standards I can confirm from the retrieved sections; the remainder should be verified in [1] and the RT-4 district standards at § 17-2-0400 et seq.:

- **Minimum lot area per unit:** [1] establishes minimum lot-area-per-unit standards for all R districts (table at § 17-2-0303-A — the specific RT-4 figure was not returned in the retrieved text). The RS3 exemption allowing 1,500 sq ft/unit in certain block contexts applies to RS3 only, not RT-4. The parcel has a 3,075 sq ft lot with 3 units — verify the RT-4 minimum (typically ~1,000 sq ft/unit) against this footprint [1].
- **Side setbacks:** No side setback standards specific to RT-4 were returned. The B/C district side setback rule requiring setbacks only when abutting R-zoned property [4] does not directly govern RT-4, but RT/RM setback rules at § 17-2-0400 should be reviewed.
- **Off-street parking location:** Required parking in RT districts must be on the same zoning lot as the dwellings served [3]. Parking is prohibited in side setbacks and within 20 feet of the front property line, unless accessed by a permitted driveway from the front [3].
- **FAR and maximum height:** The specific RT-4 FAR and height limits were **not returned** in the retrieved code text. These are set at § 17-2-0402 (height) and § 17-2-0403 (FAR) — verify directly in the Municipal Code or via the zoning map portal above.
- **Coach houses:** If you are considering an ADU coach house, [2] sets a 22-foot maximum height, requires at least 3 feet of unobstructed open space to one side property line, and limits new coach houses in RS-designated lots to ADU-Allowed RS Areas (which differs from RT-4). Coach houses in B/C districts are limited to the rear 30 feet of lot depth [2].

---

### 4. Overlays and Special Designations

This parcel carries **three active overlays** and several confirmed absences:

- **Transit-Oriented Development (CTA)** — The parcel is in a CTA TOD overlay, triggered by its proximity (0.34 mi) to Wellington station (Brown/Purple Lines).
- **ADU Eligible Area** — The parcel falls within a designated Additional Dwelling Unit-Allowed area [5], meaning conversion units and/or coach houses may be permitted subject to [2] and § 17-7-0574 limitations. ADU pre-certification is enforced by the Department of Housing [5].
- **Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) Zone** — Any qualifying residential development here triggers ARO obligations. The Lake View community area has 20 ARO-tracked projects totaling 432 affordable units, including senior and supportive housing (e.g., Britton Bud Apts., 173 units; Renaissance St. Luke Greenview Place, 97 units).
- **TIF District:** The parcel lies within the **Red and Purple Modernization Phase One Project** TIF (active 2016–2052). TIF increment financing may be available for eligible projects.

**Confirmed absences:** No Planned Development, no landmark or historic district designation, no National Register listing, no Lakefront Protection overlay, no Special Service Area, no Planned Manufacturing District, no Special Flood Hazard Area (FEMA Zone X — minimal flood hazard), and no brownfield sites nearby.

---

### 5. Parking Requirement and Transit Reduction

Because this parcel is transit-served (CTA TOD overlay, Wellington station at 0.34 mi), **the minimum off-street parking requirement may be reduced by up to 100%** under § 17-10-0102-B. [3] governs parking location in RT districts — required spaces must be on the same lot. The building's assessor record notes a 2-car garage already on site.

**Important:** No density, FAR, or height bonus applies here. RT-4 is not a dash-3 district (e.g., RT4-3), so the Connected Communities Ordinance density bonuses available in B-3, C-3, and D-3 districts do not apply. Per § 17-10-0102-B, the TOD benefit at this zoning classification is **parking relief only**.

---

### 6. Has the Zoning Changed Recently?

The current RT-4 designation is tied to ordinance **23082T1**, which is the reference on file in the city's GIS system. This ordinance number suggests a 2023 action. However, the retrieved data does not include the prior zoning classification or the legislative history of that ordinance, so I **cannot confirm what the prior zoning was or the nature of the change.** To verify: search ordinance 23082T1 in the [Chicago City Clerk's Legistar system](https://chicago.legistar.com) or call the Department of Planning and Development's zoning counter.

---

### Confidence and Limitations

**High confidence:** Zoning classification (RT-4), all three overlays, TOD parking relief, flood zone (X), TIF district, ADU eligibility, and ARO designation — all from authoritative city GIS and county parcel records.

**Could not determine from retrieved text:** Specific RT-4 FAR limit, maximum building height, and the exact RT-4 minimum lot-area-per-unit figure (the code table at § 17-2-0303-A was not returned). Prior zoning classification before ordinance 23082T1 was also not available. Assessment history and sales history returned no records.

**Verify at:** Chicago Zoning Map · Chicago Municipal Code Title 17 (§ 17-2-0303, § 17-2-0400–0403) · Cook County Assessor (CCAO) for assessment records · Chicago City Clerk Legistar for ordinance 23082T1.
